purpose: Freeze one materially distinct public exact-source qualification path for the four currently qualified BYBIT_SPOT identities whose contemporaneous GitHub-hosted PIT probes are transport-blocked with HTTP 403 on both official mainnet REST hosts before System 8 D0.

frozen_endpoint_family.instrument_identity: MEXC public spot exchangeInfo / official market metadata for exact pair identity

qualification_requirements: Each target must bind the frozen V2A asset identity to the exact MEXC spot pair; ticker equality alone is insufficient.
Preserve raw public response bytes and SHA-256 before normalization.
Record provider, exact pair, endpoint, request parameters, retrieval UTC timestamp, raw hashes and parser/schema version.
Reproduce exactly 33 unique UTC daily buckets covering 2026-08-04 through 2026-09-05 inclusive.
Fail closed on any missing or duplicate daily bucket, non-monotonic timestamps, invalid OHLC relation, negative volume, identity ambiguity or transport failure.
Do not silently fall back to another provider, pair or endpoint family after observing a result.
Historical qualification evidence carries zero prospective/scientific/economic credit and cannot repair any prior PIT snapshot.
Any source admission and 137-registry replacement must occur only after separate successful physical qualification/adjudication and before D0.
explicit_non_effects: No denominator change: eligible universe remains 137.
No D0 start or cutover claim.
No methodology, threshold, ranking, costs, clock, cutoff or family change.
No automatic registry mutation or source admission.
The existing BYBIT_SPOT qualification evidence remains preserved as historical source-QA evidence.
